related.title: 穆罕默德本拉希德太陽能園區
related.titleEn: Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum Solar Park
related.transfer: 可遷移「用地與功率密度」與「I–V 曲線與填充因子」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；穆罕默德本拉希德太陽能園區的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Land use and power density" and "I–V curve and fill factor" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum Solar Park must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦單一場址兩百萬瓩的光電廠：雙面模組的背面增益、模組數量與創紀錄的電價；穆罕默德本拉希德太陽能園區則以分期招標的單一業主園區：電價逐期下降、熔鹽塔的夜間供電與 2030 年目標為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A two-gigawatt plant at a single site: rear-side gain of bifacial modules, module count and a record tariff; Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum Solar Park centres on A single-buyer park tendered in phases: tariffs falling phase by phase, night supply from a salt tower and the 2030 target, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「年發電量與性能比」與「年發電量與性能比」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「電池溫度與功率損失」的模型移到穆罕默德本拉希德太陽能園區，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「直交流比與削峰」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Annual yield and performance ratio" and "Annual yield and performance ratio".
Move the model of "Cell temperature and power loss" to Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum Solar Park, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "DC/AC ratio and clipping", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「用地與功率密度」與「I–V 曲線與填充因子」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；穆罕默德本拉希德太陽能園區的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Land use and power density" and "I–V curve and fill factor" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum Solar Park must be respecified.

related.title: 雙面模組與反照率發電增益
related.titleEn: Bifacial Modules and Albedo Energy Gain
related.transfer: 可遷移「用地與功率密度」與「I–V 曲線與填充因子」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；雙面模組與反照率發電增益的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Land use and power density" and "I–V curve and fill factor" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Bifacial Modules and Albedo Energy Gain must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦單一場址兩百萬瓩的光電廠：雙面模組的背面增益、模組數量與創紀錄的電價；雙面模組與反照率發電增益則以讓模組的背面也發電：背面輻照度、雪地增益、扭力管遮蔭、白色地布與量測方法為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A two-gigawatt plant at a single site: rear-side gain of bifacial modules, module count and a record tariff; Bifacial Modules and Albedo Energy Gain centres on making the back of a module generate too: rear irradiance, gain over snow, torque-tube shading, white ground cover and measurement, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「年發電量與性能比」與「年發電量與性能比」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「電池溫度與功率損失」的模型移到雙面模組與反照率發電增益，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「雙面模組的量測」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Annual yield and performance ratio" and "Annual yield and performance ratio".
Move the model of "Cell temperature and power loss" to Bifacial Modules and Albedo Energy Gain, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Measuring a bifacial module", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「用地與功率密度」與「I–V 曲線與填充因子」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；雙面模組與反照率發電增益的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Land use and power density" and "I–V curve and fill factor" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Bifacial Modules and Albedo Energy Gain must be respecified.

history.title: 艾達芙拉太陽能電廠
history.text: 2019 年開始招標；2020 年以創紀錄的電價決標並完成融資；2022 年首批電力併網；2023 年全部完工並啟用。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 2019: The tender was launched. 2020: It was awarded at a record tariff and financing closed. 2022: First power reached the grid. 2023: It was completed and inaugurated. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
